verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth documents MFA for application users, using TOTP authenticator apps and phone messaging, with enrollment, challenge and verify flows and app-level enforcement guidance. It also documents enterprise SAML 2.0 SSO for project end-users with Okta, Google Workspace, Entra and others. missing for 10: explicit OIDC-based enterprise SSO evidence, detail on how MFA is enforced (it is app-level guidance rather than a platform-wide switch), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can require MFA and enterprise SSO (SAML/OIDC) for my application users

citations.quote: Supabase Auth implements MFA via two methods: App Authenticator, which makes use of a Time based-one Time Password, and phone messaging
Supabase Auth MFA for application users, with documented enrollment/challenge/verify flows and app-level enforcement guidance.
Supabase Auth supports enterprise-level Single Sign-On (SSO) for any identity providers compatible with the SAML 2.0 protocol.
Your users can use many popular Auth methods, including password, magic link, one-time password (OTP), social login, and single sign-on (SSO).
